papers.title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
papers.abstract: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

ai_summary.problem: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理不一致的序列，现有评估多依赖模型判断、参考视频或仅关注力学，缺乏对物理一致性的直接、可解释测量。
ai_summary.method: 提出一个基于测量的物理一致性基准，包含40个受控任务，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热与相变、电磁学和表面张力；每个任务配初始图像、生成提示和预定义物理标准，评估器结合任务可观测性筛选与任务特定定量物理测量。
ai_summary.result: 在8个视频生成模型的1280个视频上评估，发现持续存在的物理不一致且任务间差异大，最佳模型总分仅57.76/100；评估器在任务内排序和成对比较中与人类判断的一致性优于直接使用视觉语言模型基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了无需参考视频、跨多个物理领域、以可测量物理关系为依据的可解释评估基准。
ai_summary.relevance: 为诊断视频世界模型的物理不一致性、推动具身AI中可靠预测与规划提供了可解释的评估基础。

papers.title: PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.

ai_summary.problem: 预训练机器人策略在部署时遇到分布外（OOD）条件会性能显著下降，而基于强化学习的后训练通常需要大量真实交互，在触觉操作中代价高、慢且可能具破坏性。
ai_summary.method: 提出PEARS，一种物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，用于带触觉反馈的预训练策略高效在线自适应。其物理引导力推理（PFR）模块利用VLM中的物理先验，从视觉结果和触觉交互历史诊断失败并更新接触力边界；高频混合力-位置控制器执行这些边界。同时，触觉条件扩散引导强化学习通过调整冻结流匹配策略的潜在噪声，纠正自由空间运动和接触时序，且不更新基础模型。
ai_summary.result: 仿真中，PEARS相比各任务最强基线将成功率提升12.4-37.4个百分点，并将达到特定成功率阈值所需交互回合数最多减少53.2%；真实实验中在白板擦除和移液管液体抽吸任务上分别达到95%和90%成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 将VLM物理先验驱动的失败推理、力边界控制与触觉条件扩散引导结合，在不更新基础策略的情况下实现样本高效的触觉操作在线自适应。
ai_summary.relevance: 为预训练机器人策略在真实触觉操作中的高效、低风险在线适应提供了新思路，推动具身智能与多模态物理推理结合。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
papers.abstract: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视频编辑方法虽能插入物体，但难以让插入物体与源视频内容发生合理交互（如被拿起或操作），导致插入物体缺乏真实参与感。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ALIVE 框架，利用编辑后的首帧和仅命名新增物体的指令，让插入物体与源视频内容产生连贯交互。构建了 35,800 个编辑对（结合 3D 渲染、模型生成、真实视频及 ROSE 通用编辑对），并训练 VLM 从相同输入预测交互引导。同时提出 ALIVE-interaction 基准，从交互保真度、源内容保持和视觉连贯性进行评估。
ai_summary.result: 无 VLM 引导时，ALIVE 在两个基准上的 Overall 分别比最强基线提升 43.9% 和 4.4%；加入 VLM 预测引导后，ALIVE-interaction 分数进一步提升 0.95 分，且无需额外用户输入。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次面向首帧引导的视频物体插入，强调插入物体与源视频动作/交互的对齐，并引入 VLM 预测交互引导来增强编辑效果。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了可控视频编辑与物体级世界模型的发展，使 AI 编辑不仅“插入物体”，还能理解并生成物体间的真实交互。
ai_summary.org: 未明确提供；根据作者背景推测为 Adobe Research 与罗切斯特大学

papers.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
papers.abstract: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型已能生成逼真的视觉环境，但这些环境大多无声；需要实现实时、可交互且空间对齐的立体声音频合成。
ai_summary.method: 提出WorldSonus，一个面向世界模型的交互式视频到音频框架：采用流式因果自回归扩散架构实时生成音频块；结合以音频为中心的描述生成流程与分块索引提示调度，实现生成过程中的动态声音控制；利用立体声与Ambisonic数据构建高质量立体声监督以对齐空间信息。
ai_summary.result: WorldSonus实现0.41的实时因子，支持流中声音指令交互，并在开放域视频到音频基准上匹配或超越最先进的双向模型，在声学质量和空间对齐上表现优异。
ai_summary.novelty: 将流式因果自回归扩散、分块提示调度和立体声空间监督统一用于世界模型中的实时交互式空间音频生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态世界模型从纯视觉生成走向沉浸式、可交互的音视频环境构建。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（项目页为 noizai.github.io，可能来自 NoizAI）

papers.title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

ai_summary.problem: 现有含3D几何先验的VLM空间推理能力强但只能离线运行，需完整视频才能回答；流式VLM虽能因果处理并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式3D表示。
ai_summary.method: 提出SpaTime，一种流式VLM，在每一帧将因果几何token融入语言模型，仅依赖已观察帧进行时空推理。提出响应时间损失，将逐帧响应概率映射为可微期望响应时间，并惩罚与真实响应帧的距离。构建StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench用于流式评测。
ai_summary.result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上达到49.2%总体准确率，并将平均响应时间误差相对最强流式基线降低66%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将因果几何token逐帧融合进流式VLM，并用可微响应时间损失监督模型何时回答。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动具身智能体在视频流中实时进行3D时空推理并适时应答。

papers.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
papers.abstract: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.

ai_summary.problem: Web agent 需要读取并操作第三方编写的网页内容，因此页面上植入的恶意指令可以劫持 agent、使其偏离用户目标；而现有防御只在训练前固定的注入样本上微调，能自适应训练模型的新型攻击者可轻易绕过。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AdvSim2Real：在一个冻结的“网页世界模型”模拟器中，协同演化任务课程（curriculum）、注入攻击者与 agent 三者——课程只奖励 agent 成功率约 50% 的任务，攻击者只奖励能造成“成功翻转为失败”的注入，从而实现任务与攻击难度的双向自适应，并把训练结果迁移到真实浏览器。
ai_summary.result: 训练使 4B 模型的能力与鲁棒性同时提升：无论有无攻击，任务完成率都上升，并能抵御从未见过的前沿模型攻击者；在 150 个真实网页任务上，面对未见攻击者时完成率相对基座提升 33.6%，且能力增益可迁移到真实浏览器。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将任务课程与自适应注入攻击者在世界模型模拟器内与 agent 共同演化，并用“成功率翻转”作为攻击者奖励信号，实现可迁移到真实环境的 sim-to-real 鲁棒训练。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 Web/具身 agent 在开放不可信环境中的提示注入安全与鲁棒性训练提供了可扩展的对抗演化范式，是大规模部署自主 agent 的关键前置工作。

papers.title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

ai_summary.problem: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时，帧常被独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有检索增强方法多在帧或片段级操作，无法有效建模事件演化与相互关系。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的EC-RAG框架，先将视频划分为语义连贯的事件片段，用多模态信号表示每个事件，并按时间顺序和事件间关系链接成显式事件链；给定查询后，在事件链中定位相关事件并聚合对应模态证据。
ai_summary.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上，事件中心的设计持续优于帧级检索基线，表明建模时间结构对长视频理解很重要。
ai_summary.novelty: 将长视频检索增强生成从帧/片段级提升到事件链级，并通过结构化多模态融合实现免训练、即插即用的事件级检索与推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长视频理解提供了一种无需训练、兼容现有LVLM骨干的事件级RAG范式，强调了时间事件结构在多模态推理中的价值。

papers.title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

ai_summary.problem: 现有模型合并方法通常基于端点参数转移语言模型的推理能力，但这会混淆模型原有差异与后训练阶段获得的变化，尤其无法准确评估强化学习（RL）对视觉语言模型的影响。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Selective-RL：先隔离强化学习阶段的参数更新，发现其主方向比完整更新更具跨模型可迁移性，然后保留矩阵层面的主导方向并保持幅度，将其迁移到视觉语言模型的语言模块中。
ai_summary.result: 在三个模型家族和五个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL 在 15 组比较中有 12 组优于完整更新插值，其中在 Qwen 接收模型上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点；对照实验表明仅靠更新幅度或任意低秩分解无法复现该增益。
ai_summary.novelty: 从训练阶段视角隔离并选择性迁移 RL 更新中的主导方向，区分了后训练“学到了什么”与跨模型“什么仍可迁移”。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉语言模型高效迁移强化学习获得的推理能力提供了免训练新思路，并加深了对跨模型能力迁移机制的理解。

papers.title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
papers.abstract: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

ai_summary.problem: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠伪造检测对维护视觉信息信任至关重要；现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表示，未能充分利用模型内部的取证知识来引导检测。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Reserve-Guided Elicitation（RGE）框架，将预训练模型中稀疏、对来源敏感的内部组件视为“取证储备”。先用 Forensic Lens（F-lens）按层和 token 组分解激活并依据真假图像响应差异筛选储备位点和方向；再将所选方向映射回隐藏状态空间构建固定储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapters（FRA），固定主干、参考分类器和子空间基，只训练 FRA 系数图以生成受子空间约束的输入相关残差更新。
ai_summary.result: 仅使用 500 张带标签训练图像和低于主干 0.2% 的可训练参数，RGE 在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即取得有竞争力的性能；并且在跨越自监督和视觉语言预训练的八种编码器上持续优于对应冻结检测器，表明预训练视觉模型中广泛共享一种潜在取证能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预训练模型中稀疏且对来源敏感的内部组件显式视为可激发的“取证储备”，并通过固定子空间约束和轻量适配器将其定位转化为结构化的参数高效检测能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为图像伪造检测提供了一种参数高效、低数据依赖的潜在知识激发范式，提示预训练视觉模型中存在可迁移的通用取证表征。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失，无法识别）

papers.title: Parallel Predictive World Models for Accurate and Efficient Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon world-model planning typically relies on autoregressive rollouts, where predicted states are repeatedly fed back into the model. This preserves temporal structure but creates a horizon-length sequential path and exposes later predictions to recursive decoded-state feedback. We introduce Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict a finite-horizon trajectory in parallel while retaining causal interaction among future representations. Each horizon is conditioned on its causal action prefix, and future representations interact before decoding, separating temporal causality from state-by-state output recursion. We formalize this distinction by viewing autoregressive rollout as a causal trajectory map and identifying the decoded-state feedback pathway removed by PPWM. Across four visual-control tasks, PPWM achieves the lowest long-horizon prediction error and the highest Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) simulator success among the evaluated predictive interfaces. Meanwhile, PPWM achieves more than a 3$\times$ average CEM planning speedup over the autoregressive LeWM baseline. These results suggest that accurate and efficient long-horizon world-model planning does not require state-by-state autoregression, but can instead be achieved through parallel causal trajectory prediction.

ai_summary.problem: 长时程世界模型规划通常依赖自回归展开，导致随预测步数增长的串行计算路径，并使后续预测暴露于递归的解码状态反馈中，带来误差累积和规划效率低的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出并行预测世界模型（PPWM），在保留未来表示之间因果交互的前提下，并行预测有限时程轨迹。每个时程以其因果动作前缀为条件，未来表示在解码前交互，从而将时间因果性与逐状态输出递归分离。
ai_summary.result: 在四个视觉控制任务中，PPWM 取得了最低的长时程预测误差和最高的 CEM 模拟器成功率，同时相比自回归 LeWM 基线实现了超过 3 倍的平均 CEM 规划加速。
ai_summary.novelty: 将自回归展开形式化为因果轨迹映射，并识别/移除了解码状态反馈路径，提出并行因果轨迹预测的世界模型接口。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明准确且高效的长时程世界模型规划不一定需要逐状态自回归，可通过并行因果轨迹预测实现，对世界模型、规划与智能体研究有启发。

papers.title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

ai_summary.problem: 遥感场景分类中，现有视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间，CLIP类方法依赖静态图文对齐，而多模态大模型对明确候选类别的分类任务仍进行不必要的自回归文本生成，导致效率低且未必最优。
ai_summary.method: 提出RSJEV，一种单次多模态决策框架，将遥感场景分类重构为候选条件化的多模态判别式决策过程。该方法联合建模视觉表示、任务指令和候选类别语义，并引入OnePass Decider直接提取多模态决策状态、在候选类别空间内估计类别概率，从而省去自回归解码但保留视觉-语言交互。
ai_summary.result: 在UC Merced、AID和NWPU-RESISC45三个基准上，RSJEV优于代表性CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP和MLLM方法，并仅用0.8B参数模型显著降低推理成本，取得更好的精度-效率权衡。
ai_summary.novelty: 将多模态大模型用于遥感场景分类时从自回归生成式分类改为候选条件化的单次判别式多模态决策，并用OnePass Decider直接估计类别概率。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明状态条件化的多模态判别决策可提升高效遥感图像理解，并为MLLM在明确候选类别分类任务中的高效应用提供新思路。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构信息未明确给出；从作者背景推测可能为武汉大学。

papers.title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

ai_summary.problem: 现有医学图像深度学习模型常直接将图像特征映射到疾病标签，未显式评估临床医生系统采用的形态学和纹理标准，导致诊断透明度不足，可能影响临床安全部署。
ai_summary.method: 提出MedCORE，一种在视觉-语言架构中操作化临床推理的结构化诊断框架。它将诊断过程分解为临床定义的准则，对每个准则进行空间定位，采用多尺度表示编码宏观结构和微观纹理证据，并用图注意力网络建模准则间依赖；同时将准则表示与临床文本描述对齐，通过类别视觉原型强化，并使用不确定性校准加权聚合证据。
ai_summary.result: 在ISIC 2018皮肤镜病变分类、BUSI乳腺超声病变表征和IDRiD糖尿病视网膜病变分级上，MedCORE分别达到89.2%/85.7%/96.4%、96.1%/95.2%/98.4%、84.3%/80.2%/92.8%的准确率/macro-F1/AUC，持续优于CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、概念型和原型型基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 将临床准则显式分解、空间定位、多尺度证据编码、图注意力准则依赖建模与不确定性校准加权统一到可解释医学图像诊断框架中。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动医学AI从黑箱标签预测走向基于临床准则的可解释推理，有助于提升诊断透明度和临床部署安全性。

papers.title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

ai_summary.problem: 智能仓库中的无人机语言条件控制仍缺乏同时包含连续低级飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述和真实工业环境的基准与数据集。
ai_summary.method: 提出WareFly-VLA，一个真实感UAV VLA框架与数据集：在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中采集507条人类遥操作飞行episode和8,504个高分辨率RGB transition，每条配对目标工人外观描述与同步四自由度控制命令；覆盖目标接近和人员跟随两类空中任务，并在无泄漏episode级协议下对SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0和OpenVLA四种开源VLA架构建立统一基准。
ai_summary.result: 结果表明仓库中语言条件空中控制远未解决：严格泛化设置下性能显著下降，连续动作建模一致优于离散动作token化，仅前向通道可从单帧可靠学习，且现有基础模型接口从地面/人形具身迁移到空中平台效果较差。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向智能仓库语言引导人体搜索、定位与跟踪的真实感UAV VLA框架、数据集与统一评测基准，并提供同步视频、语言、动作、位姿和难度标注。
ai_summary.relevance: 为语言驱动的空中自主性和世界模型研究提供数据、基线与协议，推动VLA从机械臂和地面移动平台向无人机具身智能扩展。

papers.title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

ai_summary.problem: 交互式视频世界模型在生成每一段视频时需要进行多步去噪，计算开销大；现有的免训练缓存方法只依据模型内部去噪动态决定复用，忽略了用户控制信号的变化，导致在动作切换时生成质量下降。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CtrlCache，一个免训练的控制感知缓存框架：根据动作在块间与块内的变化，将每个块标记为 initial、transition、turning 或 steady 状态，在选定的中间去噪步上让 initial/transition 块做完整计算、turning/steady 块复用同一块内最近一次完整计算得到的 transformer 残差；并引入频率混合的历史先验引导，利用前一个干净潜变量的低频结构信息，无需额外的 DiT 前向传播。
ai_summary.result: 在 Matrix-Game 2.0 与 LingBot-World v1/v2 上，无需重新训练即可实现 1.21x–1.41x 的 DiT 主干加速，且三个模型的 WBench Overall 分数均优于原始推理。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次显式利用交互式生成中“控制信号先于去噪到达”这一零成本信号，将动作变化检测与频域持久性结合来调度缓存与残差复用。
ai_summary.relevance: 为交互式视频世界模型的实时推理加速提供了通用、即插即用的免训练方案，有助于推动可交互世界模型在实际系统中的落地。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者机构信息（作者包括 Shangye Song、Dong Gong、Hong Jia、Yun Sing Koh、Xinyu Zhang，机构字段为空）

papers.title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
papers.abstract: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态几何对齐分数（基于Gram行列式）在模态退化时如何响应尚不清楚；论文检验其响应是否主要由扰动位移的幅度决定。
ai_summary.method: 在MSR-VTT和DiDeMo冻结队列上施加受控视频模糊与音频噪声，分析关系几何的响应；提出Gramian体积的一阶展开——方向几何响应（DGR），将位移投影到局部体积梯度，联合刻画干净工作点、位移幅度和位移方向。
ai_summary.result: 位移幅度最多解释15%的样本外方差，匹配幅度样本仍系统性不同；DGR绝对一阶项取得0.838–0.969的样本外R^2、0.864–0.963的匹配幅度排序准确率和0.909–0.989的响应符号准确率，方向无关替代方案弱或不稳定，增益归一化候选未通过预设门控。
ai_summary.novelty: 指出多模态几何分数对退化的响应本质上是方向依赖的，并用DGR将响应分解为工作点、幅度与方向的联合作用。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态表征的鲁棒性评估与几何对齐分析提供了方向敏感且可解释的新视角。

papers.title: A Belief-State World Model for Catheter Navigation under Sparse Fluoroscopy: A Planar Proof of Concept
papers.abstract: Endovascular catheter navigation relies on continuous fluoroscopy, exposing patients and clinical staff to ionizing radiation throughout the procedure. We investigate whether a physics-based world model can sustain the navigation task between deliberately sparse X-ray acquisitions, and whether the model can signal when its internal state estimate is no longer reliable. We formulate sparse-fluoroscopy navigation as a partially observable Markov decision process where a Cosserat rod simulator supplies transition dynamics, sparse noisy projections provide observations, and a particle filter maintains a belief over the device state, reduced in this implementation to a tip state with a geometric contact proxy. We evaluate this formulation in a deliberately simplified setting: a synthetic planar vessel phantom with a quasi-static rod model and simulated projections, without clinical or animal data. In this setting, the belief-state model tracks the simulated tip with a root mean square error of 1.30 mm while acquiring observations at one fifteenth of the continuous rate (0.97 mm at every frame, 1.51 mm at one thirtieth), reported 90 percent credible intervals achieve 0.92 empirical coverage, and the belief-derived contact risk estimate discriminates unsafe contact events with an AUROC of 0.68. These results constitute a proof of concept on a simplified simulation rather than a demonstration of clinical readiness; their purpose is to establish that calibrated belief, rather than point-estimate accuracy alone, is the essential property a sparse-imaging world model must deliver.

ai_summary.problem: 血管内导管导航依赖连续X光透视，使患者和医护人员持续暴露于电离辐射；论文探索能否用基于物理的世界模型在刻意稀疏的X射线采集之间维持导航，并判断其内部状态估计是否仍可靠。
ai_summary.method: 将稀疏透视导航建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程：Cosserat杆模拟器提供状态转移，稀疏带噪投影作为观测，粒子滤波维护器械状态信念，并在当前实现中简化为尖端状态与几何接触代理。评估采用刻意简化的合成平面血管体模、准静态杆模型和模拟投影，不使用临床或动物数据。
ai_summary.result: 在该简化仿真中，信念状态模型以连续帧1/15的观测频率实现1.30 mm的尖端跟踪RMSE（每帧为0.97 mm，1/30频率为1.51 mm），90%可信区间达到0.92的经验覆盖率，基于信念的接触风险估计区分不安全接触事件的AUROC为0.68。作者强调这只是简化仿真中的概念验证，并非临床就绪证明。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出并验证了在稀疏透视下以校准的信念状态而非单点估计精度为核心的世界模型导航框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 对AI领域而言，该工作为部分可观测环境中的世界模型、机器人导航和不确定性校准提供了具体案例，尤其对医疗机器人中的稀疏感知与安全风险估计有启发意义。

papers.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.

papers.title: RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon urban navigation requires sequential local decisions whose errors can compound over time. Imitation learning (IL) rarely learns from failures, while physical trial-and-error reinforcement learning (RL) is costly. Action-conditioned world models can provide imagined feedback by predicting visual consequences for candidate actions. However, a frozen world model may become less reliable as the policy evolves. In this paper, we introduce RIWANAV, a post-training framework that casts the coupled adaptation of a world model and an action model (policy) as task-specific recursive self-improvement (RSI). Each cycle alternates two updates. The world model evaluates policy actions through imagined outcomes, providing comparative feedback for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). The improved policy then constructs a grounded self-curriculum, selecting expert-consistent action-video pairs by behavioral novelty and prediction error. The refined world model supplies feedback for the next policy update, closing the recursive self-improvement loop. Experiments show that RIWANAV outperforms training baselines and prior methods, validating the proposed recursive self-improvement loop between the policy and world model. Real-world trials further demonstrate its practical applicability.

papers.title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

papers.title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
papers.abstract: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

ai_summary.problem: 作物早期胁迫检测对提高农业效率很重要，但高光谱成像和AI系统成本高、复杂，难以被中小农户采用。
ai_summary.method: 提出CropSentry，一个低成本地面多机器人系统，使用两个自主机器人逐行采集叶片颜色和环境数据，并进行空间映射后发送给主机器人，生成实时网页仪表盘展示作物健康状态。
ai_summary.result: 在63次观测中，整体作物健康分类准确率为84.12%，健康、缺素和患病植物分别为82.60%、88%和80%；10次从机观测的无线通信成功率为100%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将群体协同多机器人、低成本多模态叶片感知和实时可视化仪表盘结合，用于农业行栽作物的早期胁迫检测。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了低成本机器人群体与多模态感知在精准农业和野外具身智能中的应用潜力，但算法与AI创新有限。
